mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates below 0.25% compress the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.5% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% MoM, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector weakness that precedes corporate profit slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 5-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100k indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC over 5-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation rise (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS remains stable (within 0.1% MoM), or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery, sustained retail sales growth (RSAFS) above 0.5% MoM signals accelerating consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-pandemic recovery when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.05.
